title: Oozy Creamy Mediterranean Corn Paella
description: A salty and creamy Mediterranean dish featuring cornmeal and lardons, perfect for a monsoon evening. This ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly recipe combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with the comfort of a warm, oozy paella.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced lardons and cook until crispy, then remove from the pan and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
Add the corn kernels to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add the cornmeal to the pan and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the smoked paprika to the pan and stir to combine.
Return the cooked lardons to the pan and stir to combine with the cornmeal mixture.
Top the paella with crumbly feta cheese and cook until melted and oozy.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
